headline: Colombia's Ecopetrol Scheduled to Report Third-Quarter Results on Nov. 10
summary: State-controlled oil producer Ecopetrol will publish its third-quarter financial results on Nov. 10. The announcement follows a second-quarter profit of approximately $1.88 billion.
why: Ecopetrol is Colombia's largest energy company and a major oil producer in Latin America.

impacts.name: Ecopetrol SA
impacts.why: The earnings announcement date sets expectations for upcoming financial results.
